title: CorpusDocumentManifest
description: Manifest for a single corpus document. 15 fields per docs/00-scope-and-decisions.md §10.2; enums per docs/03-thiet-ke-he-thong.md §3.9.1; validation rules per docs/06-test-evaluation.md §6.2.1.1. reviewed_by/reviewed_at are required only when review_status is ACCEPTED or REJECTED (docs/03 §3.9.3 / DB DDL 3.10.4: nullable columns, review_status defaults to PENDING; docs/00 §10.2 review-bat-buoc). effective_to > effective_from is enforced by the validator script because draft-07 cannot express cross-field date comparison.

source_url.description: Official source URL of the document.

file_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest (lowercase) of the downloaded source file.

effective_from.description: ISO 8601 effective start date (date-only allowed). Nullable when effectiveness is not yet determined (e.g. PENDING review); required once review_status is ACCEPTED (docs/03 §3.10.4).

effective_to.description: ISO 8601 effective end date (date-only allowed). Nullable for currently effective documents; must be strictly after effective_from when both are present.

relation_notes.description: Free-text notes on legal relations (amendment/replacement/repeal); may be empty.

reviewed_by.description: Reviewer identity; null while review_status is PENDING; required when review_status is ACCEPTED or REJECTED.

reviewed_at.description: ISO 8601 review timestamp; null while review_status is PENDING; required when review_status is ACCEPTED or REJECTED.

allOf.description: reviewed_by/reviewed_at become required once a reviewer decision (ACCEPTED/REJECTED) is recorded.
An ACCEPTED manifest must have a determinate effective start (effective_from non-null, valid date) per docs/03 §3.10.4.

When both effective_from and effective_to are present, effective_to must be strictly after effective_from. JSON Schema draft-07 cannot express the date ordering natively; the validator script enforces it.
